title: Purblind
summary: PUR'BLIND, adjective [said to be from pore and blind.] Near sighted or dim sighted or; seeing obscurely; as a purblind eye; a purblind mole.

inlines.v: PUR'BLIND, adjective [said to be from pore and blind.] Near sighted or dim sighted or; seeing obscurely; as a purblind eye; a purblind mole.
